messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: embeddings-reranker pipeline errors detected in prod (high error rate on /v1/batch-embed). P95 latency spiking. Root TS 1812345600
sara: seeing a lot of 400s from batch endpoint, and downstream reranker failing with 'vector len mismatch' errors. Customers reporting search dropouts. tagging ml-oncall and devops.
matt: on it, collecting logs now. rough error rate ~ 12% over last 10m.
jin: quick question—any recent deploys? I see a dedicated image push 3h ago to embedder:v2.3.4.
sara: yes deploy at ~1782340000-ish, but we also rolled quantization tweaks in the same window.
ml-oncall: taking lead for triage. my plan: 1) confirm scope (which endpoints + regions) 2) try routing to fallback model variant 3) collect full error samples and timelines.
oliver: confirmed errors in us-west-2 and eu-west-1, not in apac. batch endpoint /v1/batch-embed returns HTTP 400 with body: 
```
{"error":"ValueError: expected vector length 1024 but got 1023"}
```
sara: that log matches what I pulled from the reranker pods:
```
2026-03-15T17:02:12Z reranker-0 ERROR: downstream embedder returned vector shape (1023,) for doc_id=abc123
2026-03-15T17:02:12Z reranker-0 ERROR: failing item id=abc123 => aborting rerank
```
matt: hypothesis 1: padding/trimming bug in batcher causing one-off length. hypothesis 2: quantized model changed embedding dim by mistake (bad model artifact).
jin: ran a quick diff of model metadata on the host: embedder:v2.3.4 metadata shows dim=1024, but the artifact in s3 for the quantized build has meta.dim=1023.
ml-oncall: that's a smoking gun. who owned the quantization job? @sara ?
sara: it was run by infra-ml pipeline (jenkins/job/quantize-embedder). I saw a partial failure in the job at 15:40 that retried automatically. maybe the retry produced a malformed artifact.
support-lead: customer impact: two enterprise tenants experienced failed search / degraded ranking for ~25 minutes (17:00-17:25). I opened P0 support threads.
oliver: mitigation proposal: 1) route traffic for batch endpoints to embedder:v2.3.3 (previous known-good) via routing flag 2) disable quantized artifact in catalog 3) patch pipeline to validate artifact meta on publish.
matt: implementing routing change now: kubectl patch svc embed-batcher -n prod -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"route-to":"v2.3.3"}}}}}' || using feature-flag rollback tool. will update when rolled.
ml-oncall: also enabling fallback in reranker to request embeddings from the sync single-embed endpoint for items that error, until routing is complete. adding a short-circuit to avoid 400s.
(5m later) matt: routing change applied, traffic shifted to v2.3.3 in us-west-2. error rate dropping to 0.5% in that region. eu-west still recovering.
jin: pulled artifact from s3: s3://redwood-artifacts/embedder/quantized/v2.3.4/manifest.json shows "dim": 1023. storing as evidence.
sara: collecting list of affected request IDs and sample payloads for RCA. can everyone paste logs they have found into the incident doc?
oliver: timeline draft: 
- 15:36: quantize job started
- 15:40: quantize job partial failure and auto-retry
- 16:12: deploy embedder:v2.3.4 (quantized) pushed to prod
- 16:58: first 400s observed on /v1/batch-embed
- 17:00: incident-bot alerted (error rate > 5%)
- 17:10: ml-oncall engaged
- 17:18: routing rollback to v2.3.3 began
- 17:25: major error reduction, mitigation in place
- 17:30: on-call handoff to night shift (ml-oncall -> oliver)

matt: adding log extraction command for anyone who needs raw entries: 
```
kubectl logs -l app=embedder -n prod --since=2h | grep -E "vector|ValueError|manifest.json" -C 3 > /tmp/embed-logs.txt
```
ml-oncall: tracking open hypotheses in-thread: 
H1: quantize pipeline produced malformed artifact (evidence: manifest.dim=1023) ✅
H2: runtime batcher trimming payloads incorrectly (evidence: looking for traces in batcher logs) 🔄
H3: downstream reranker not validating received vector length (evidence: reranker errored instead of requesting fallback) 🔄

sara: customer comms draft: "We experienced an issue with embeddings deployment causing some search results to fail between 17:00-17:25 UTC. We have rolled traffic to a verified model version and are investigating to prevent recurrence." please review.
support-lead: approved, will send once RCA preliminary notes in.
jin: next steps for RCA owners: 
- infra-ml: add artifact validation gate (verify manifest.dim == model.expected_dim) before publish (owner: infra-ml)
- serving: add defensive check in batcher to assert vector dims and pad/trim safely (owner: eng-runtime)
- reranker: implement graceful fallback when embedding length mismatch occurs (owner: eng-ml)
- postmortem: correlate customer request IDs and construct timeline + impact table (owner: support-lead)

oliver: on-call handoff note: taking over at 17:30, I'll continue with evidence collection and start a postmortem draft. tagging next-shift.
incident-bot: Incident status update: mitigation active, severity downgraded to SEV3. Next update in 30m or on-handoff.
